To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
active anomaly detection is a better alternative than unsupervised anomaly, and that it has a cost that is similar to unsupervised anomaly.

we propose a novel layer that can be added to deep learning models for unsupervised deep anomaly detection to make them active anomaly detectors, and that the resulting method can be used in real-world anomaly detection tasks with good performance.

(1) unsupervised anomaly detectors can be turned into active anomaly detectors by attaching our new layer; (2) the new layer has no additional computational cost, and (3) active anomaly detection is more effective in practice than unsupervised methods, as shown in experiments.
